versions.changelog:
- Updated internal runtime/run.mjs with minor adjustments.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- No changes to skill description, supported features, or core workflow.

- Improved runtime documentation and operation guide in references/runtime.md.
- Various updates to runtime scripts for stability and feature checks.
- Removed unused skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of yaps-image-generate.
- Create images from prompts using Yaps; save results or generate stickers.
- Requires Yaps v2.3.124+ and user sign-in.
- Supports checking hardware, model availability, and configurable output size.
- Sticker output needs additional background removal capability.
- Includes safeguards: no infinite retries, no unsupported hardware claims, and no automatic file overwrites.
